The '''3K40 Targeting System''' was a high-quality type of [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] produced by the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]]. It was often found on space stations or military bases to coordinate multiple weapon systems at once, whether to accurately track individual targets or coordinate fire on a single target. The system also improved the targeting ability of any gunners using a weapon system controlled by the 3K40, with an upgrade package which doubled its efficiency.<ref name="HS" />
